Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Rowe
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 04/12/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 582 as introduced could decrease the expenditures and the administrative obligations of the Alabama Surface Mining Commission by an estimated $9,500 annually, by reducing the minimum required number of commission meetings from once monthly to every two months.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Rowe
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 04/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 582 as passed the House of Representatives could decrease the expenditures and the administrative obligations of the Alabama Surface Mining Commission by an estimated $9,500 annually, by reducing the minimum required number of commission meetings from once monthly to every two months.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
